meta.title: Anthropic hits $1.3T, an AI math proof claim, Apple's agent | Daily AI & Tech
meta.description: Anthropic's first day on Nasdaq, a claimed AI-assisted proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and a job listing that hints at Apple's AI agent.

beats.voice: Here are today's biggest AI and tech updates.
First up. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, is now a public company.
On its first day of trading, Anthropic's shares opened thirty four percent above the IPO price and closed seventeen percent up. That puts its market value at about one point three trillion dollars.

right.name: Close
facts: No shares for over half the bidding funds

beats.voice: The stock gave back some of its first jump, but it still ended the day well above where it started. Demand was so high that more than half of the big funds that bid got no shares at all.
Next. A huge claim from the world of mathematics.

props.label: Claim?
props.headline: A claimed proof of the *Riemann Hypothesis*

points.text: One of math's biggest open problems
Reports say AI played a role

props.tip: A proof only counts once other mathematicians verify it.

beats.voice: A mathematician claims a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, one of the biggest open problems in mathematics. Reports say AI played a part in finding it. It was the most discussed story on Hacker News, but experts are still checking the work.
So, not proven yet. But definitely one to watch.
And finally. Apple might be building its own AI agent.

props.title: What Apple's *agent* could do
props.tip: It's a job listing, so there's no launch date yet.

beats.voice: According to Bloomberg, an Apple job listing describes an AI agent that can write code, browse the web, control apps, navigate devices, and coordinate smaller sub-agents for users.

beats.voice: That's today's update. Which story surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for daily AI and tech updates.
